card.name: Hall Corack
card.text: Make a splash! (As long as Hall Corack entered this turn, you may activate one of its activated abilities once without paying its mana cost.) [+1]: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains vigilance until end of turn. [-2]: Tap target artifact or creature. Put a stun counter on it. {5}: Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

card.name: Tezzeret, Darksteel Rodent
card.text: Indestructible (Effects that say "destroy" don't destroy this planeswalker.) [+1]: Put up to one artifact or creature card from your graveyard on the top of your library. Then you may draw a card. If you do, discards a card. [-2]: Target artifact or creature you control becomes a 5/5 artifact creature for as long as you control a Tezzeret planeswalker.
